name: Colorado
summary: Businesses deploying high-risk AI systems must disclose AI interactions and consequential decisions to consumers, document risk-management practices, and offer correction/appeal channels.

disclosure.headline: AI in use — Colorado SB 24-205 notice
disclosure.body: This service uses an artificial intelligence system to {purpose}. Under Colorado SB 24-205 you have the right to know when AI is making a consequential decision about you, request a human review, and correct factual inaccuracies that influence the outcome.
